svg.title: Payment System — End-to-End Pay-In, Settlement & Pay-Out Architecture
svg.desc: Comprehensive architecture of an enterprise payment platform showing PCI-DSS tokenized checkout, ACID dual-table state machine, idempotent execution with retry queue and DLQ, multi-PSP routing, async webhooks, multi-receiver event bus, double-entry ledger, settlement reconciliation, and payout rails.
svg.text: Payment System — End-to-End Pay-In, Settlement & Pay-Out Architecture
PCI-DSS v4.0 Scope Reduction · Dual-Table ACID State Machine · Idempotency Nonce & DLQ · Double-Entry Ledger · 3-Tier Reconciliation · Pay-Out Rails
SAQ-A scope: PAN never touches app
Direct HTTPS post to PSP iframe
Zero raw credit card storage on origin
Rate limiter + token bucket per buyer
Risk score passes -> proceed to order split
Strict read-from-primary PG or Raft SQL
Splits cart into per-seller payment orders
Zero duplicate charges on client retries
Full jitter prevents thundering herd on PSP
DLQ triggers on-call pager & manual audit
Circuit breaker opens on PSP 5xx surge
Route by currency, fee tier & uptime score
Funds reserved on buyer card credit line
PSP pushes async signed webhook on capture
Transitions status to SUCCESS or FAILED
CDC Outbox publish · Idempotent fan-out to 5a (Ledger/Wallet), 6 (Reconciliation), 7 (Pay-Out)
Amounts in integer minor units (no float!)
Emits order fulfillment event to warehouse
See Module 24 for Wallet Raft & CQRS internals
T+1 clearing batch file (CSV / camt.053 / BAI2)
Ingested via secure SFTP / Object Store lakehouse
Contains net settlement, interchange fees & refunds
Matches psp_tx_id + amount + currency -> mark SETTLED
Known variance (interchange delta, FX spread, fee tiers)
System generates compensating journal entry automatically
Missing internal txn or chargeback dispute -> Finance Ops
DLQ queue & workflow audit dashboard with rollback audit
AP platform integration: Tipalti / Stripe Connect
OFAC and sanctions verification on pay-out account
Batch ISO 20022 XML (pain.001) / Direct API clearing
Bank confirmation triggers final debit: cash_in_transit -> bank
